blind.description: A stylized antique harpsichord or spinet with a dark green painted case, gold leaf floral ornamentation, and a gold rim around the closed lid. The front features an exposed keyboard with white and dark keys framed by warm wood. The instrument is supported by turned wooden legs joined at the base by a connected wooden stretcher frame. Geometry is solid, clean, and continuous without floating artifacts or melted parts.
blind.from_above: An elongated asymmetrical harp-shaped lid with a rounded narrow tail and a flat keyboard end, colored dark olive green with a golden floral vine painted down the center and a gold border.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 40-45% of the figure's height (around 2.5 feet tall), roughly 4.5 feet long, and about 2 feet wide at the keyboard.
